metadata.title: प्रधानमंत्री जनमन ओडिशा के लिए काफ़ी नहीं | PM-JANMAN is not enough for Odisha? Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
The Odisha PVTG Empowerment and Livelihood Improvement Programme (OPELIP) has sparked significant controversy amidst plans to launch its second phase (OPELIP-II). At the heart of the debate is the Odisha government’s decision to secure a ₹734.86 crore loan from the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) to fund the programme, despite substantial financial outlays already allocated under the Central Government’s PM-JANMAN Mission.

Critics argue that seeking an international loan imposes an unnecessary financial burden on the state, especially when ₹24,104 crore has been allocated under PM-JANMAN for holistic development of PVTGs nationwide, including Odisha. Tribal rights experts have raised concerns over the lack of transparency regarding the outcomes of OPELIP Phase I, pointing to incomplete project closure reports and underutilized funds that failed to deliver tangible benefits in many PVTG villages.
